about.text: is a hard sheep's cheese that can be grated, like Parmesan cheese. Sometimes goat or cow milk is used. It is a specialty from Karacabey, a town in Bursa province which was called Mihaliç during the Byzantine and Ottoman periods. Mostly it is produced from non-pasteurized milk and processed with salt.

sources.text: Hard grating cheese from Karacabey; curds hardened in hot water, salted, stored in brine. Wikipedia names sheep milk only; ripening time not given
